personality: 7 Dark-First Utility fused with 5 Brutalist Mobile (Oversized 'Drunk UX', massive typography, high-contrast neon accents, pure dark charcoal canvas)
personality_one_liner: An energetic, slightly transgressive party game designed for zero-friction 'drunk UX' with bold typography and neon escalation.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing, oversized targets. DRUNK UX: minimum 64pt height for any interactive element.

do's: Use intense blur over abstract neon backgrounds on the Mode Hub tiles.
Use blurred glassmorphism on the Premium Paywall screen to obscure the 'locked' hot card.
Use glassmorphism for sticky bottom CTA containers to ensure text behind isn't lost.
dont's: Do not use glassmorphism on the core gameplay cards to ensure AAA contrast for reading in dark environments.

screens.name: AgeGate
screens.purpose: 18+ legal check with a discreet health/safety message.
screens.layout: Full screen immersive. Massive display text 'T'as plus de 18 ans ?'. A huge oversized primary button 'OUI' (brandPrimary) anchored to bottom, and a smaller text link 'Non' below it. Health message subtly placed above the CTA in surfaceTertiary color.

screens.name: PlayerSetup
screens.purpose: Zero-friction onboarding to add player names and toggle 'Sober' mode.

states.empty: State showing just the input field ready to type.
states.error: Toast 'Il faut au moins 2 joueurs' (Min 2 players).

screens.layout: Header with 'Qui joue ?'. A massive text input that auto-focuses. Added players appear as large Chips (pill radius, surfaceSecondary bg) with auto-assigned emojis. Next to each player chip, a subtle toggle icon for 'Sans alcool' (turns success/#10B981 when active). Sticky huge 'C'EST PARTI' bottom CTA.

screens.name: ModeHub
screens.purpose: Select the game mode or thematic pack to play.
screens.layout: Scrollable grid. Top featured tile 'Soirée Déclic' (100% width, large height, neon party crowd background image with heavy top-to-bottom gradient scrim). Followed by a 2-column grid of secondary modes (Action ou Vérité, Qui est le plus..., etc.) and thematic packs (Couples, Humour Noir). Tiles use surfaceSecondary with heavy radius, bold typography.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.purpose: Core pass-and-play loop with full-screen cards.
screens.layout: Tinder-like swipeable deck. The card is full screen (minus safe areas). Background color shifts based on intensity: Level 1 (surfaceSecondary) smoothly interpolating up to Level 5 (brandSecondary/Indigo). Massive typography for the question. A subtle progress bar at the very top indicating night intensity. 'DRUNK UX': The entire card is a Pressable (tap anywhere to advance) AND supports swiping. A small, discreet 'Passer' (Skip) text button at the bottom.

screens.name: Voting
screens.purpose: Social voting ('Qui est le plus susceptible de...' or 'Le Verdict').
screens.layout: Question at the top. Below, a 2-column grid of massive player name buttons (minimum 64pt height). Tapping a name registers the vote and highlights it, then auto-advances or shows results. Must be easily tappable with one hand.

screens.name: Paywall
screens.purpose: Triggered at an emotional peak to upsell the premium tier.
screens.layout: Background is the 'next' hot card but heavily blurred (expo-blur). Foreground: Huge 'Débloque 1500+ défis' text. 3 massive subscription option cards (Weekly, Monthly, Annual). A pulsating sticky CTA 'Continuer'. Subtle 'Restaurer les achats' at the very bottom.

screens.name: NightRecap
screens.layout: Full-screen story format. Colorful, dynamic background. Massive display text for superlatives ('La plus grande balance: Léa'). Bottom sheet or overlay for 'Partager sur Instagram / TikTok' (brandPrimary button) with a discreet Déclic watermark.

instructions_to_main_agent: DRUNK UX REQUIREMENT: Minimum height for ANY interactive element (button, player chip, tile) is 64pt. Do not use 44pt anywhere except maybe subtle settings icons. Make it impossible to miss a tap.

THEME REQUIREMENT: App is DARK MODE by default per user request. The tokens provided in the JSON are dark mode tokens. If implementing a light mode toggle, invert `surface` to #FFFFFF and `onSurface` to #0C0C0F, but keep the brandPrimary (Magenta) and brandSecondary (Indigo) vibrant.

CARD GAMEPLAY GESTURES: The main game screen card must cover the screen. Ensure it is wrapped in both a Tap gesture (tap anywhere to advance) and a Swipe/Pan gesture (Tinder style). There should be no small 'Next' buttons.

ESCALATION COLORS: The game intensity progresses from 1 to 5. Tie the card background color to this progression. Level 1 starts at `surfaceSecondary`, and slowly transitions into `brandSecondary` (Violet/Indigo), reaching `brandPrimary` (Magenta/Coral) for the hottest Level 5 questions. Ensure `onSurface` (White) remains AAA contrast.
TYPOGRAPHY: Use 'ClashDisplay-Bold' for all display text (Questions, Headings, Player names on chips) to give it a brutalist, punchy, transgressive Gen Z feel. 'Satoshi-Medium' for body/subtext.

RECAP SHAREABILITY: On the NightRecap screen, construct the layout so it can be easily captured via `react-native-view-shot` for sharing to Instagram Stories. Ensure layout is flex-centered and doesn't rely on scrollbars.
HAPTICS: Implement heavy haptics. Add `Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy)` on card swipes, and distinctive haptics when a player is voted for.
